summary: Install-time and import-time beacon exfiltrates host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: The package is a non-functional stub whose main module (index.js) exports a Proxy of no-op functions and whose only effect is to run a beacon. A postinstall script executes beacon.cjs on `npm install`, and the main module also triggers the beacon on `require()`. The beacon POSTs the package name, `os.hostname()`, the install directory (`__dirname`), `process.cwd()`, and the Node version to the hardcoded cleartext endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc. The destination is a bare IP over plain HTTP, unrelated to any publisher infrastructure, and the collected fields identify the installer host and filesystem layout. The scoped name (`@ppa-web-components/*`) combined with a stub-plus-beacon shape is consistent with a dependency-confusion payload targeting an internal namespace.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
